question_set_contract.dependency_contract: Exactly two questions use prior learning: q01 directly retrieves Lesson 1 and q07 mixes W = Fs from Lesson 1 with the current conservation account.
question_set_contract.difficulty_progression: direct work retrieval, three conceptual diagnostics, a one-stage account, a linked graphical account, then a mixed work-and-conservation application

evidence_basis.originality_note: Every context, value, wording and figure brief is original. The mapped evidence supplies only conservation, dissipation, ratio, linked-stage and graph-construction demand patterns.

visual_planning.asset_note: The q06 graph scaffold and q07 transfer-path sketch are planned only. No question assets were created.

questions.prompt: A student pushes a storage box with a constant horizontal force of 48 N through 3.5 m in the force direction. Calculate the work done on the box and state what this work represents physically.
Which statement gives the principle of conservation of energy for a complete account?

options.A: Energy can be created whenever a force moves an object.
options.B: Energy can be destroyed when it becomes difficult to use.
options.C: Energy cannot be created or destroyed, but it can be transferred between stores and across a system boundary.
options.D: Only energy in a moving object needs to be counted.

questions.prompt: A mixer receives 900 J of energy. The mixture gains 610 J and sound carries 40 J to the room. How much energy increases thermal stores in the mixer and surroundings?
A flywheel and its bearings receive 520 J. The flywheel's chosen store increases by 440 J and the bearings warm by 80 J. Which conclusion is correct?

options.A: Energy is not conserved because the flywheel received only 440 J.
options.B: Energy is conserved only if the bearings are outside the system.
options.C: The 80 J has been destroyed by friction.
options.D: The full account conserves energy because 440 J + 80 J = 520 J.

questions.prompt: A rescue winch pulls a sled with a constant force of 260 N through 7.5 m in the force direction. During the pull, a stated store of the sled increases by 1.42 kJ and the winch, rope and snow gain 410 J in thermal stores. Sound carries the only other energy transfer. Use the system boundary shown in the planned sketch.
